name: Default
shortDescription: Web UI that finds duplicate videos and images by visual similarity, even across different resolutions, frame rates or watermarks, with FFmpeg bundled.

alerts.message: Sign in with the generated VDF_WEB_PASSWORD from the environment. The app only scans files inside the container: copy your videos into the /media volume, then add /media as a scan directory.
Upstream designs the web UI for local networks and advises against exposing it to the internet. The generated password is its only protection, so keep it private.
